title: Lean formalization: An O(n log n) algorithm for the open vehicle scheduling problem on a line with release times
description: Lean 4 formalization accompanying the paper by Bo Hu and Xiaoyu Liu. It proves that the event-driven algorithm returns the minimum finish time for every input, that its main loop halts within 8m+10 iterations, and that the loop costs O(m log m) in the standard cost model, under every tie-breaking rule among queue minima.
